text:
paloma: quick design check — toolbar primary CTA feels cramped against the search field on narrow widths. also the label voice is inconsistent (we have 'Start' on some CTAs and 'Run' on others). screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/toolbar-gap.png ryan: yep i see it. spacing token looks like 8px there. for toolbar CTAs i'd prefer 12px so icon+label has breathing room. also +1 to standardizing on 'Run' for action verbs. meenal: will bumping that token affect other components that rely on --spacing-compact? sam: probably. i'd rather we add a toolbar-specific token to avoid regressions: `--spacing-toolbar-compact` set to 12px, keep `--spacing-compact` at 8px. paloma: i like that. current token lives in tokens/spacing.json as `--spacing-compact: 8px`. proposed quick patch: ```css :root { /* new, toolbar-only compact spacing */ --spacing-toolbar-compact: 12px; } .toolbar .cta { margin-left: var(--spacing-toolbar-compact); } ``` alex: accessibility nit — when the CTA kicks off a job we show a toast. currently the toast doesn't set aria-live and is not focusable on error. for screen reader users we should use `role="alert"` or `aria-live="assertive"` for failures and `aria-live="polite"` for success. also make error toasts focusable so keyboard users can act. meenal: agree. sample toast patch: ```html
Job failed to start.
``` sam: +1 to toolbar-specific token and explicit aria handling. @paloma can you add a short storybook story showing the toolbar at narrow widths with the new token? add a snapshot test for spacing so we catch regressions. :thumbsup: paloma: will do — i'll open a PR after updating tokens & toasts. i'll also replace 'Start' with 'Run job' on the toolbar CTAs to keep voice consistent. design-bot: design tokens updated in Figma (file: Toolbar Kit) — https://figma.redwood.example/file/toolbar-kit (placeholder sync message) sam: SGTM. once PR is up i'll do a quick visual pass and check a11y with NVDA. paloma: thanks all — tracking: PR -> tokens + toolbar story -> toast aria fixes -> snapshots. closing loop here.
